name: anim_jyu_walk
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches, a big round belly, a grumpy face with the mouth closed, straight thick human legs with bare human feet
desc: A slow, heavy, lumbering walk: a full walk cycle in place with two clear steps, keeping the same three-quarter view as the first frame: the body never turns sideways. Clear strides with the feet well apart: first the near leg swings forward and plants its foot in front while the far leg pushes off behind, then the legs pass each other, then the far leg swings forward and plants in front while the near leg is behind, then they pass again. The legs never cross. The opposite arm swings forward with each step, the body bobs 2 or 3 pixels up and down, the big belly jiggles. The body does not move across the frame. The face keeps the same grumpy stern look with the mouth closed. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
